Recommendations are getting worse
Spotify’s recommendation algorithm, including the Radio feature, has a frustrating tendency to drift towards mediocre, generic music rather than genuinely interesting tracks related to what I’m listening to. The longer it plays, the less relevant and distinctive the recommendations seem to become.

More recently, I’ve also heard songs elsewhere—particularly on the radio—that I’ve then searched for on Spotify only to discover they aren’t available. That’s particularly annoying for a service whose main attraction is supposed to be having an enormous music catalogue.

Spotify is still a good service, but both the quality of its recommendations and gaps in the catalogue are becoming increasingly frustrating.

text:
The Best Music App ever🫠💗 🎧
Spotify is genuinely one of the best apps for music lovers. The whole experience feels so smooth, aesthetic, and perfectly made for anyone who can spend hours listening to music. From discovering new songs to making playlists for every possible mood, Spotify has literally everything.

What I love the most is how easy it is to find exactly what I’m in the mood for. Whether I want happy songs, sad songs, chill music, old classics, new releases, or songs that match a specific vibe, Spotify somehow always has something perfect. The recommendations are honestly amazing, and discovering a song that becomes your new favourite is one of the best things about using it.

The playlists are another huge reason why Spotify stands out. You can create playlists for literally anything—late-night thoughts, road trips, studying, relaxing, getting ready, romantic vibes, nostalgic songs, or just random songs you’re obsessed with at the moment. And Spotify makes all of it feel so organised and personal.

Spotify Wrapped is also ICONIC. 😭 The way it turns your entire year of listening into something so fun and personal is honestly unmatched. Seeing your top artists, favourite songs, listening personality, and all those little statistics is something I look forward to every year.

The interface is simple, the music library is massive, the recommendations are great, and the overall experience is just chef’s kiss. It doesn’t feel like I’m simply using an app to play music—it feels like I have my own little music world.

Spotify deserves all the love because it makes listening to music so much more fun, personal, and enjoyable. 💚🎶

Infinity /10. Would recommend it to literally every music lover. Spotify is THE BEST 🎀🎀

text:
Spotify Review
Spotify is one of the most popular music-streaming platforms, and it is easy to see why. It offers millions of songs, podcasts, audiobooks and playlists in one convenient app. Its simple design, personalised recommendations and large range of content make it a strong choice for people who listen to music regularly.

One of Spotify’s biggest strengths is its music library. Users can find music from almost every genre, including pop, hip-hop, rock, R&B, country, electronic and classical music. It is also easy to search for specific artists, albums or songs. Spotify’s personalised playlists, such as Discover Weekly and Release Radar, are particularly useful because they introduce users to new music based on their listening habits. This makes the experience feel more personalised than simply searching for individual songs.

The app is also easy to use. The interface is clean and straightforward, making it simple to create playlists, save songs and switch between devices. Spotify Connect is another useful feature because it allows users to control playback on compatible devices. The platform also provides useful features such as lyrics, collaborative playlists and personalised year-end statistics through Spotify Wrapped.

However, Spotify is not perfect. Free users have to deal with advertisements and restrictions on how they can control their music, while Spotify Premium requires a subscription. Some users may also find that the constant recommendations and large amount of content can make the app feel overwhelming. The audio quality is good for most listeners, but people who want the highest possible sound quality may prefer other streaming services.

Overall, Spotify is an excellent all-round music-streaming service. Its huge library, personalised recommendations, easy-to-use design and social features make it enjoyable and convenient. Although the Premium subscription can be expensive and there are some limitations for free users, Spotify remains one of the best choices for discovering, organising and listening to music. I would recommend Spotify to anyone looking for an easy and reliable way to listen to a wide variety of music in one place.

text:
Für nächstes Spotify Update
Hallo liebes Spotify-Team,

ich hätte einen kleinen Verbesserungsvorschlag für die Spotify-App.

Auf der Startseite werden unter „Zuletzt gehört“ die Playlists, Alben oder Songs angezeigt, die man zuletzt angehört hat. Ich fände es sehr praktisch, wenn man einzelne Einträge dort gezielt ausblenden könnte.

Meine Idee wäre, dass man beispielsweise eine Playlist oder ein Album unter „Zuletzt gehört“ länger gedrückt hält und anschließend die Option „Nicht mehr anzeigen“ auswählen kann. Der Eintrag würde dann nur aus dieser Übersicht entfernt werden und natürlich nicht aus der eigenen Bibliothek gelöscht.

Ich denke, diese Funktion wäre für viele Nutzer hilfreich, da man manchmal bestimmte Inhalte nicht mehr in der „Zuletzt gehört“-Übersicht sehen möchte, ohne gleich die gesamte Höraktivität deaktivieren zu müssen.

Vielen Dank, dass ihr euch den Vorschlag durchlest! Vielleicht könnt ihr diese Funktion ja in einem zukünftigen Update umsetzen. 😊

Viele Grüße
